Node.js and npm to run the server
limits: Available tools and access depend on the upstream server and account permissions
Live account access has not been verified for this extension package
pricing: Your service plan, API access requirements and usage quotas apply; no subscription is included.
privacy: Requests and authorized account data are exchanged with the configured service. Server output may enter agent context as untrusted content.
tagline: Review PayPal invoices, orders and transactions
description:
Bring PayPal invoices, orders and transactions available to your account into APX. Choose the record relevant to a question and examine its returned information before deciding what follow-up is needed.

An invoice, an order and a transaction are related but are not interchangeable proof of payment. Keep their identifiers and statuses distinct in a review. Available tools and actions depend on PayPal and your account permissions. The extension does not include a PayPal plan, cover transaction fees or authorize a payment simply because you asked to inspect a record.
prompts: Review the available details of the PayPal invoice I select.
Read the status returned for the order I choose without changing it.
Explain the available transaction information and avoid treating an invoice as proof of payment.

es.tagline: Revisá facturas, órdenes y transacciones de PayPal
es.description:
Traé a APX las facturas, órdenes y transacciones de PayPal disponibles para tu cuenta. Elegí el registro relacionado con tu consulta y revisá su información antes de decidir cómo seguir.

Una factura, una orden y una transacción están relacionadas, pero no son pruebas de pago intercambiables. Distinguí identificadores y estados al revisarlas. Las herramientas y acciones dependen de PayPal y de tus permisos. La extensión no incluye un plan, cubre comisiones ni autoriza un pago sólo porque hayas pedido consultar un registro.
prompts: Revisá los detalles disponibles de la factura de PayPal que elija.
Leé el estado devuelto de la orden que seleccione sin modificarla.
Explicame la información disponible de la transacción sin tratar una factura como prueba de pago.
